errors.quote: assign each vertex the projection $P_U$ onto its label
errors.problem: The paper's $P_U$ is the projection onto $U$ along $U^\perp$ for the form $x^{\mathsf T}(I-J/9)y$, which is not the Euclidean orthogonal projection. Without 'along $U^\perp$' the projection is unspecified, and the identity for $P_V-P_U$ needs this choice.

errors.quote: $P_V-P_U$ is the identity on $V\cap U^\perp$ and zero elsewhere
errors.problem: The paper says 'zero on its orthogonal complement', i.e. on $U\perp V^\perp$. 'Elsewhere' (the set complement) is not a subspace.

This holds mod 4 and only for an increasing edge ($V=U\perp E$). For a decreasing edge, such as center $3\to4$, the paper negates the right side. The page then counts kernels over all edges without mentioning that case.

errors.quote: since $C=iZC^{-1}Z$, signs $Z$ before and $i^{27}Z$ after give $C$
errors.problem: The signs must act only on the 27 coordinates of $\operatorname{supp}u_a$ (the paper's $Z_{a,k}$). $Z$ on all $m$ coordinates would turn the other factors $C$ into $aI-b\tau$. $i^{27}$ is the one-column case of the paper's $i^{27k}$.

errors.quote: Undoing the bank exchange gives all roles $C^{\otimes m}$.
errors.problem: The scalar exchange sends $Y_a$ to $X_a$ with sign $-1$, and the paper also negates the physical $X$ outputs. Read literally, the page's 'undoing the bank exchange' leaves that route at $-C^{\otimes m}$.
